name: cc-global-setup
displayName: Global setup: guardrails, status line, project standard, parallel pilot
description: User-scope Claude Code setup for every project: ask before commit/push/merge, rm→trash, a rich status line, a project-config standard with path-scoped rules, and a pilot that runs parallel sessions in tmux + git worktrees.

git_guard.title: Ask before commit / push / merge / PR
git_guard.description: Push, merge and gh pr create/merge always ask. Commit asks unless the project sets CLAUDE_GIT_GUARD_ALLOW=commit and the branch is not protected.

protected_branches.title: Protected branches
protected_branches.description: Space-separated branches where commits always ask, even in opted-in projects.

safe_rm.title: Turn rm into trash
safe_rm.description: Rewrite `rm` commands to `trash` so deletions stay recoverable. No-op when no trash command is installed.

project_audit.title: Flag repos without Claude config
project_audit.description: At session start in a git repo without CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md or .claude/, Claude offers /cc-global-setup:project-config.

pilot_model.title: Model for pilot code sessions
pilot_model.description: Passed as --model to each code session the pilot launches.
